findings.title: The first-article U3.3-to-R127.1 meter check says 'it must read open', but an intact board reads a diode drop plus 0.91 kOhm in one polarity
findings.contradicts: The procedure's own source, round23_safety_severity_check.md 'Recommended fix' item 1 (lines 212-213): 'Require no beep and > 100 Ohm. The expected readings ... a diode-plus-1 kOhm path or open if intact'. Also the copper (R127 to GND on PE4's net) and ST DS12110 Rev 8 Table 120 p. 213 (FT_xxx pins: injected current -5/+0 mA; note 4: a negative injection is induced by VIN < VSS, so the pin conducts from VSS when pulled below it).
findings.evidence: Same sentence ('meter U3.3 (QSPI_IO2) to R127.1 (the PE4 gate network): it must read open') at docs/ORDERING.md:651 (section 8 first-article list), docs/M3_R10.md:1088-1089 (Firmware rule 3), docs/FMEA_REDUNDANCY.md:38 (I-2 row) and the binding note's rule 3 (generated from m3_design/r10_sch_check.py:366 into r10_binding_note.json). Board a0ec075e (pcbnew): PYRO1_GATE_N = {U1.3, R126.1, R127.1}; R127 1k R127.1 -> GND; R126 220R to PYRO1_GATE, R128 10k to GND; QSPI_IO2 = {U1.1, U3.3} only. DC resistance R127.1 -> GND = 1k || (220 + 10k) = 910.9 Ohm. From GND to QSPI_IO2 the VSS-side input clamps of U1.1 (PE2, FT_h, Table 9 p. 64) and U3.3 conduct forward when R127.1 is the positive probe. Diode test (about 1 mA): about 0.6 V + 0.91 V = about 1.5 V displayed, not OL; ohms mode on any meter whose test voltage exceeds a junction drop: a finite kOhm reading. Reverse polarity: open. So an intact board fails 'must read open' in one polarity on common meters, while a sub-0.45 V ohms meter shows open both ways: the result depends on instrument and polarity. Not raised in round 24-27 triage observations.
findings.impact: A required first-article check can reject good boards (or invite the technician to pick the polarity that passes). No safety impact: the failure direction is a false reject.
findings.concrete_fix: In all four places replace 'it must read open' with the source's criterion, e.g. 'no continuity beep and > 100 Ohm in both polarities (intact: open one way, about a diode drop plus 0.91 kOhm the other; bridged: near 0 Ohm)'; regenerate the binding note from r10_sch_check.py.

findings.title: parts_qualification.md still calls PB1 a TT_a pin; DS12110 gives TT_u, and R10_VALIDATION says the docs already say TT_u
findings.contradicts: ST DS12110 Rev 8 Table 9 p. 70 (LQFP100 pin 35, PB1: I/O, TT_u, ADC12_INP5); pin_table.tsv row 35 and the binding note obligation (R5-MCU-04) both say TT_u; R23-MCU-04 / D-R23 (R10_DECISIONS.md:3767) corrected the same phrase in the binding note only. docs/R10_VALIDATION.md:1915 states 'CAD lane (binding note); docs already say TT_u'.
findings.evidence: m3_design/assembly_review/sources/r10_design/parts_qualification.md:913-914 (committed 19dd0b5): 'An open R105 puts CAM_5V (5.456 V nominal) on PB1 through R104 10 kOhm; PB1 is a TT_a pin with a 4.0 V limit (reviewer)'. Datasheet text extracted from the cached DS12110 Rev 8 PDF (.supervisor/r14_parts_pdf/st_h743.pdf), page 70: '35 ... PB1 I/O TT_u ... ADC12_INP5, COMP1_INM'. Board: CAM_5V_SENSE = {U1.35, R104.2, R105.1, C94.1}. The 4.0 V limit is unchanged (Table 119 p. 212 gives 4.0 V for all TT_xx pins), so only the pin-type statement is false.
findings.impact: A false datasheet fact in the parts record, and a false 'docs already say TT_u' line in the validation record.
findings.concrete_fix: parts_qualification.md:914: 'TT_a pin' -> 'TT_u pin (DS12110 Rev 8 Table 9 p. 70)'; R10_VALIDATION.md:1915: note that parts_qualification was corrected in the round 28 fix pass (or drop 'docs already say TT_u').

pin_table port-to-pin-number column matches DS12110 Rev 8 Table 9 LQFP100 for all 100 pins; every cited Table 9 page and AF-table page (Tables 10-14, pp. 89-96) contains the cited row.

AF numbers checked against Tables 10-14: TIM5 AF2 (PA0-3), QUADSPI AF9 (PB2, PD11-13, PE2) and AF10 (PB6 NCS), SPI1 AF5, SPI3 AF6, I2C1 AF4, USART3 AF7 (PD8/9), UART5 AF14 (PB12/13), USART6 AF7 (PC6/7), UART7 AF7 (PE7/8), OTG_FS AF10; PC1 AF0 TRACED0, PE4 AF0 TRACED1, PE2 AF0 TRACECLK; PC1 additional function RTC_TAMP3/WKUP5.

Pin types as cited: PA4 TT_a, PA5 TT_ha, PA6 FT_a ADC12_INP3, PC0 FT_a ADC123_INP10, PC5 TT_a ADC12_INP8, PB1 TT_u ADC12_INP5, PB12/13 FT_u, PD8/9 and PC6/7 FT_h, PE4 FT_h. PE7/PE8 are TT_ha (no doc claims otherwise).
U1 footprint numbering is counter-clockwise (a rotation of the standard LQFP100 order, not a mirror); pin 1 is adjacent to pin 100.

Every DS12110 citation in the binding note checked against the Rev 8 PDF text: Table 146 p. 238 (LSI 29.4-33.6 kHz), Tables 11/12/13 pp. 91/92/94, Table 119 pp. 212-213 and notes 3-4, Table 120 note 3 p. 213, Table 122 note 3 p. 215, Table 157 note 7 p. 247 (VIH 0.7 VDD, RPU 30-50 k), Table 159 p. 249, Table 160 note 2 p. 251, Tables 127-128 pp. 218-219, Table 192 p. 293, Figure 95 p. 286, Table 189 p. 291, Table 9 note 7 p. 88, Table 126 p. 217, Table 147 p. 239: all Rev 8 and as stated.

Copper facts in obligations confirmed: R127 1k, R126 220R, R128 10k, C126 220 nF (gate), C128 100 nF (drain); R122 1k / R123 2k / C123 10 nF on Q122; R162 1k / R163 10k on Q123; R60 100k / R61 10k / C60 10 nF (PA6 /11); R104 10k / R105 1k (PB1 /11); 2x5.1k over 2k||2k (PC0 / PC5 /11.2); R9 / R110 1k (PC8 VBUS/2); R460-R464 10k to 3V3; R10 / R11 10k; R12 / R13 4.7k; R5 BOOT0 10k; R431 100k, R102 10k, R432 10k; U5 PS high CSB low (0x77); U3.3 = QSPI_IO2, R127.1 = PYRO1_GATE_N; VBAT and VREF+ tied as stated.

Calculations re-run: IWDG 960 LSI cycles 28.571-32.653 ms, fault bound 34.853 ms; PE4 gate 0.104 V and PC1 gate 0.218 V against a 30 k pull-up at 3.6 V; PC1 high 2.2 V / 1.1 mA; PC8 2.20 V at VBUS 4.4 V vs VIH 2.31 V; PA6 loader drive <= 0.36 mA; PA3 <= 0.83 V; R162 <= 3.36 mA; PB1 fault 0.15-0.19 mA: all correct.

Clearances re-measured: 3V3/3V3A to PYRO1_GATE_N/PYRO1_GATE >= 1.059 mm (F.Cu, R128.1 to via (19.55,55.825)); BUZZ_DRV to PYRO1_OUT 0.794 mm (B.Cu, R162.1-R173.1, disclosed); ACT_EN_MCU to NRST via 0.425 mm; QSPI_IO2 track to U1.3 0.550 mm (disclosed).
TPS2121 ST meaning (low = IN2 = pin 2 RAW_PROTECTED; high = IN1 / Hi-Z), Table 9-3 on PDF p. 18 and Table 9-1 on p. 13 as cited; TXU0202 U12 pin use (A1 in from PE8, A2Y out to PE7) correct.
